title: The immunological role of the pericardial adipose tissue in obesity
summary: In dieser Studie sollen die Veränderungen des Fettgewebes bei der Entwicklung einer Adipositas molekularbiologisch untersucht werden.

interventions.name:
Patients with obesity (BMI > 30 kg/m2)
Molecular biological analyses are performed to characterise differences in the adipose tissue between the two studied groups.
Control group: Patients with BMI < 25 kg/m2

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
BMI > 30 kg/m2 OR BMI < 25 kg/m2
Exclusion criteria:
none
